canonical_facts.statement: Ollie Finch took the gardener's spare shed key at 09:20 to retrieve the sleeping tonic stored there.
Dot Marsh handed Basil Thorne an envelope of photographs at 10:40 as part of her blackmail.
Ollie Finch plated the judge's tasting slice separately on a blue plate at 11:45 and dosed it.
Basil Thorne collapsed at 12:05 after tasting the lemon tart.
